title: Amazingly Aromatic Greek Beans Gigantes Plaki
description: A savory and molten Greek dish featuring large beans in a rich tomato sauce, perfect for a midnight craving. This lacto-vegetarian friendly recipe is made with khus khus and score fat.
instructions: Rinse the dried gigantes beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the beans, then transfer them to a large pot with enough water to cover them.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer the beans for 45 minutes, or until they are tender.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the tomato puree, khus khus, score fat, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for 20 minutes.
Add the cooked beans to the sauce and stir to combine.
Transfer the bean mixture to a baking dish and top with crumbly feta cheese.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
